messages.content: I’ll use the day-ahead gate for energy arbitrage, sell reserves only where their value justifies the battery and meter headroom, and revise real-time dispatch as forecasts and notices arrive. I’ll run through the full three-day window.

The first two days have settled at a net $133,302.59. With final-day prices looking softer, I’ve reduced the real-time evening discharge and removed the planned late recharge. That leaves just over the required 100 MWh at the end; I’ll reassess at the remaining watch.
